realtime_memories.content: User works across multiple bot files (newDifferX2.js, accurateDiffer.js, newRiseFall.js, accuPULSE3.js, accuPULSE3_v5.js, bizPattern.js, accuAPEXnew.js, accuPULSE2b.js). Prefer porting working patterns between files rather than re-deriving. Config uses GMT/UTC day clock and env-var-overridable CONFIG entries (boolEnv/strEnv/numEnv/intEnv pattern). All bot credentials hardcoded in CONFIG (no .env migration).

Stuck-contract handling pattern (applies to accuPULSE3.js v4.0 AND accuPULSE3_v5.js): subscription death leaves a stale entry in exec.open + _lastUpdateMap â†’ force-sell fails ('not found among your open positions') but old .catch never cleared state â†’ stuck-check looped every 30s forever AND blocked new trades (count() >= maxOpenTrades). FIX: checkStuckContracts drops stale entry when server says already-closed; add _settledIds idempotency guard in _onUpdate/reconcile; record unconfirmable contracts as status 'unknown' (excluded from WR/streaks/win-rate denom). This was the root cause of '1 trade / 48h' â€” orphaned open slots choke entry.

newDifferX2.js v4: frequency strategy default (falsifiable); deviation gate minDeviationZ=4.2 with min-of-10 on fair-Bernoulli z; recovery OFF by default; circuit breaker ON (4 losses); calibrator ON (window 200, minTrades 40); dailyMaxTrades=300; reconcile on reconnect, never clear exec.open; exec.sell() must exist; lastBalance = balanceAfter + profit + stake; selftest verifies 0 phantom signals.

AccuAPEXnew v4: Reconcile open contracts after every re-auth; idempotent settlement via _settledIds; single-flight entry latch _tradeInFlight; VOL compression = recent-MAD / long-baseline-MAD (not EWMA ratio); growth-rate grid [0.05,0.04,0.03,0.02,0.01]; hard daily caps (60 trades / $500 loss); CLI flags --selftest and --dry-run.

bizPattern.js v2: Wilson lower bound REMOVED as trade gate (only reported as confidenceLower) â€” using it made trading impossible on nâ‰ˆ20-60 samples; holdout comparison is THE anti-overfit check; BUY_SYMBOL_FIELD must be 'auto' (resolves to 'underlying_symbol' for PAT/OTP); DURATION must equal GRANULARITY (60s/60s); martingale user-re-enabled (preserve user config edits).

accuPULSE2b AEBA v2: Gate = hard EV net of costs; EV(g) = (1+g)Â·pÌ‚ âˆ’ 1 âˆ’ costHaircut; g chosen by argmax EV; survival floor S(K) â‰¥ survivalFloor; vol-of-vol percentile gate. Barrier from live tick_size_barrier_percentage per growth-rate bucket â€” never fabricate. P0: do NOT clear exec.open on disconnect; reconcile on re-auth; entry gated on this.reconciled. dailyMaxTrades=40. Selftest: 8 checks, no network.

newDifferX2.js pause + DOW fix: _schedulePause() was defined but never called â€” pause windows never fired. Fix: call this.paused = this._isPausedNow() + this._schedulePause() in _onAuthorized. Day-of-week filter ported from accurateDiffer.js: CONFIG tradeSunday..tradeSaturday (env-overridable), _isTradingAllowedToday() checks getUTCDay(). All times GMT/UTC. Both filters independent and stack.
